name: Beam
author: nixfred
description: Your Omarchy desktop on your iPad. Guided setup, instant connection details, and a clear view of what is ready.

barWidget.description: Stream your desktop to Moonlight on iPad. Click to set up or connect.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Beam checks every two seconds while streaming or making changes.

schema.label: Keep this session awake during a stream
schema.description: Temporarily inhibits automatic idle and locking while streaming. A manual lock still needs to be unlocked at this computer.

schema.label: Show the status beside the dot
schema.description: Displays set up, iPad or live beside the Beam dot.
